description: Historical database fixtures for migration-compatibility CI. Each case describes one app data dir (slot) with all four core databases pinned at a historical schema tuple, seeded with deterministic SQL, optionally history-mutated, then upgraded to HEAD via the production MigrationCoordinator::run_all().

fixture_kinds.bootstrap_sql: Deterministic fixture: the harness replays the real (immutable) historical migration scripts up to schema_tuple via the production refinery runners, then applies the seed SQL and history_ops. No binary artifacts are stored in the repository.
fixture_kinds.release_binary: Reserved for future fixtures captured from packaged releases: a real .db file committed (or fetched) as a binary artifact, referenced by the `binary` field. No such fixture exists yet; the harness fails loudly if it encounters this kind, instead of pretending to download artifacts.

cases.source_release: first consolidated schema epoch (app builds ~2026-01-30, pre-refinery bookkeeping for chat_v2/llm_usage)
cases.expected_semantics: All seeded user data survives ~6 months of migrations: notes/questions/mistakes/usage rows intact, notes_versions table dropped by V20260214 (data intentionally discarded), legacy 'deleted' chat session re-interpreted as 'archived' by V20260502, FTS and note_tags backfilled at HEAD, malformed JSON columns tolerated end-to-end.

cases.source_release: near-HEAD 2026-07 schema epoch with corrupted refinery bookkeeping
cases.expected_semantics: A near-current database with malformed migration bookkeeping (version=0/empty-checksum rows and an orphan sessions_new table) self-heals: malformed rows are purged, the orphan table is dropped, and remaining newest migrations are applied. Unknown checksum drift is intentionally covered by a separate fail-close test rather than silently repaired. Pomodoro updated_at backfill only touches NULL rows; the chat FTS rebuild fixes ghost/missing entries; automation_definitions gains trusted_profile_json.

cases.source_release: 2026-05 schema epoch where the V20260523 history record was lost after its DDL had been applied (partial-migration residue)
cases.expected_semantics: vfs schema is physically at V20260523 but its history row is missing. Re-running that migration verbatim would die on 'duplicate column'; the production make_alter_columns_safe defense must pre-mark it as applied (exactly one history row, no duplicates) and continue to HEAD. Seeded todo/pomodoro/automation/usage rows survive.

cases.source_release: v0.9.44 (2026-08-09), with historical Anki library rows containing nullable optional JSON and truly NULL source_type/source_id rows (including dedup-key collision pairs)
cases.expected_semantics: The exact v0.9.44 database tuple upgrades to HEAD; nullable Anki tags/images/extra fields normalize to valid empty JSON, truly NULL source_type/source_id rows normalize to '' without tripping idx_anki_cards_dedup_unique (colliding groups keep the newest live row and tombstone the rest via deleted_at), and existing critic `_qa_flags` and image `_occlusion` payloads survive unchanged.
